name: creativebranding/creative-search
description: Search for WooCommerce: live suggestions, typo tolerance, SKU and attribute matching, an index of its own, analytics, an accessible search bar.

infection:sql: npx wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/creative-search/tools/integration -- phpdbg -qrr -d memory_limit=-1 ../../vendor/bin/infection -c infection.json5 --threads=1 --no-progress
scripts.i18n:pot: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/creative-search -- wp i18n make-pot . languages/creative-search.pot --domain=creative-search --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,tools,tmp,docs,assets/src
scripts.i18n:po: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/creative-search -- wp i18n update-po languages/creative-search.pot languages/
i18n:check: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/creative-search -- wp i18n make-pot . tmp/i18n-check.pot --domain=creative-search --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,tools,tmp,docs,assets/src
scripts.i18n:mo: npx wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/creative-search -- bash -c 'rm -f languages/*.json languages/*.mo && wp i18n make-mo languages/ languages/ && wp i18n make-json languages/ --no-purge'
